title: Locally constructible ordinary direct-image ranks on residue-field fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat proper and locally of finite presentation, with $X,S$ schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $E$ a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Fix $r\in\mathbb N$. Write $q_s:X_s\to X$ and $p_s:X_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ for the fibre projections [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field]. Then $\{s\in S\mid p_{s,*}q_s^*E\text{ is finite locally free of rank }r\}$ is locally constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Here $q_s^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], $p_{s,*}$ is ordinary module pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and fixed rank means [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. No constant-rank assumption is imposed on E along a whole fibre.

proof.text: Use finitePresentation_projective_sections from [lem-pc-finite-flat-affine-sections-projective] on every affine open of X. Projective modules are flat. Flatness of f gives flatness of the affine coordinate ring over the base coordinate ring; Module.Flat.trans proves E.IsFlatOver f. Finite local freeness supplies finite presentation. Properness supplies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness, so apply [lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change] to K = Rf_*(E[0]) to obtain perfectness and arbitrary canonical module base change.

For the residue-field morphism g, unpack the universal-property specification of derivedPullback on p = pullback.fst f g, as in [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Identify its underived functor with tensorPullback by functor extensionality, and evaluate its derived counit at E[0] to construct the comparison c. Compose the scheme derived base-change map with Rq_*(c), where q = pullback.snd f g. Its defining witnesses satisfy [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map], so [lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change] makes this map invertible. Apply degree-zero homology. The proved source-library Functor.homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso identifies H^0(Rq_*(p^*E[0])) with R^0q_*(p^*E); Mathlib Functor.rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf identifies this with ordinary q_*(p^*E), since pushforward preserves finite limits. These are the right-derived functors defining [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Evaluate on the whole field spectrum and restrict scalars through GammaSpecIso to obtain the private fibre_homology_iso.

Apply finiteFiberCohomology from [new-perfect-finite-residue-cohomology-finite] to the strictly perfect neighbourhood supplied by perfectness at s. Transfer finite dimensionality along fibre_homology_iso. The proved source-library Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff_finrank_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj detects the fixed-rank predicate [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] by the dimension of global sections on a field spectrum. LinearEquiv.finrank_eq then identifies this dimension with derivedFiberBetti S K 0 s [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. Set extensionality proves equality of the ordinary rank locus with the degree-zero Betti level set.

At each point, [lem-pc-strictly-perfect-finite-free-refinement] replaces the strictly perfect neighbourhood by a bounded finite-free representative. Forget its lower bound; this directly gives the bounded-above finite-free witness for pseudo-coherence [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. No finite-Tor-dimension conclusion is required. Apply the level-set conjunct of [lem-sc-perfect-jump-loci] at degree zero and rank r, and rewrite by the equality of loci proved in the preceding step. No nonempty fibre or positive-rank assumption is used.
